chapter: Woodstock, MCA and the Standards Trio
title: Moving to the Woodstock area and having the house built
summary: They moved upstate in the early 1970s, rented in Mt. Tremper, and then had a simple house built from scratch.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: So, we had been talking off mic with Lydia and you about your relocating from New York, going to New Jersey and then coming up here. How long have you been up here? When did you first move up here to the Woodstock area?
Well it had to have been in the early 70’s, because Minya our daughter was born up here around that period. We’ve been up here over thirty-five, maybe almost forty years.
Is this the original place that you had once you moved up here?
No, we rented a place while this place was being built. We rented a place in Mt. Tremper.
So, you had the entire house built?
Yeah, it was built from scratch. We bought the land, and we had the house built.
Did you provide the architectural plans?
Well, loosely we did. It’s a simple house.
With the idea of having a studio in the basement? A recording studio, I should say.

No just a place for me to do what I needed to do. We liked the mountains. We looked around at places. We looked at houses and we decided that it would be nice to have our house built. That way when we go away and come back our vibe would be in it to welcome us when we come back. That’s turned out to be true.
